negative_evidence_definition: Zero configured writer scheduled/started/completed telemetry and zero server-side write_file operation-start/prepared/flushed receipts in the complete saved control surfaces. Not a claim about model intent, partial arguments or unseen model-visible advertisement.
single_read_error_cause: UNKNOWN; error boolean exposed, error message/body deliberately not read
permission_definition: Only saved host-request and control telemetry surfaces checked; no claim about unexposed model-side invalid requests.

clock.definition: Original600-second allocation counts setup/cleanup; inherited native work stop totalminus30. 575.502 includes cleanup, not a shortened grant/new response limit.

source_evidence.time_semantics: Native target.updatedAt is its last record-update time; not necessarily an independently observed transition event.

direct_native_goal.status_definition: Last directly observed saved native Goal status at the stated source time. Not router outcome, quality grade, current process occupancy or billing.

router_status_source.definition: Driver/router result only; not used to populate native_goal_status

neutral_transport_binding.suffix_scope: Common transport-only schema/path/adoption/inventory directives; scientific prefix never decoded or selected.

alias_metadata.source_usage: bundle_carrier.validate_profile checks stage identity; actor.writer_alias is read only when copying DELIVERY_MANIFEST.native_surface_writer_binding, not for tool dispatch/authorization/argument validation.
alias_metadata.prospective_action: Explicitly label logical writer kind and configured native surface in a new metadata version with both-arm closure before a fresh first stage; do not mutate active/frozen profiles or scientific prompt.
